name: The Holy Innocents
history: The children of Bethlehem killed by King Herod in his attempt to destroy the newborn Christ. The Church honours them as martyrs, who confessed Christ not by speaking but by dying.
meditation: Pray today for children who suffer, born and unborn.
prayer: O God, Whose praise the Innocents, Your martyrs, this day proclaimed, not by speaking, but by dying, put to death in us all the wickedness of sin, so that Your faith which our tongue professes may be proclaimed also by our life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
